title: jitso init in a project without jitso/jitso.yaml creates the allowlists skeleton, so the guard has a project to protect
source: intended: jitso init, one command for every adoption step (owner request 2026-11-23)
intent: INTENDED behavior. The guard does nothing in a folder without jitso/jitso.yaml, so init creates the skeleton (version and comments, no list, the same file build new writes) when the primary checkout has none. Every allowlist is then open, so a build can be composed and launched at once. It is a brief preview line, and --remove leaves it alone: it holds the project's own restrictions.

## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
